verdict.rationale: Apify publishes a documented REST API v2, including webhook endpoint docs, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.apify.com/api/openapi.json. Official JS and Python API clients are well documented: running Actors and retrieving results, tasks, pagination, retries, typed error handling, log streaming and async support. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the platform through the API.
